name: Lighter Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange pocket lighter with a black band, a silver top and a tall pink flame
entry: It flicks its pink flame on and off to startle people. It lights campfires when it is in a good mood.
how: Use a Lighter Flint on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Flamethrower in this form.
